0.comment: Anton Zarkovich Karnatsky: Nothing Passage disaster
0.content: A Fatui company was posted at Nothing Passage while Karnatsky and Preobrazhensky quarrelled and experimented. Private Pyotr Orlov's diary records strange drag marks, a wail only one man heard, and unnatural cold and mould before the end. His last note, asking that Smirnova be cleared of desertion, says the two researchers' experiments birthed the catastrophe.
